card.name: Casual, chatty blog writing style
card.fires_on: Small grammar words (the, is, to, have, 's) and sentence-ending periods in informal, chatty web writing, where a slangy or quirky word often comes next. The text is blog or pop-culture commentary, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Linking words in chatty prose
modes.description: Words like the, is, to, have or 's inside a casual, humorous sentence, just before an idiom or slangy phrase.
modes.example: You know how when someone compares dealing with their dog to dealing with a baby and all the parents in the room give them<< the>> stink eye?

modes.label: Sentence end in a quip
modes.description: A period closing a wry aside in a blog post about media or pop culture.

modes.label: Exclamation or aside
modes.description: A word in an excited or joking remark about a person or event.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward informal slang and pop-culture words such as awesome, badass, weird, vibe and nerd.
card.plain: It fires on small words in casual, joking blog writing, where a slangy word is likely to follow.
